`include "disciplines.vams"
module m(input a, output y, inout r); electrical a,y,r; analog begin V(y,r)<+2*V(a,r); end endmodule
spectre_deck:
simulator lang=spectre
ahdl_include "dut.va"
Va (a 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 1 1]
Xdut (a y 0) m
simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-7 vabstol=1e-9 iabstol=1e-12 precision="%24.17g"
tran tran stop=1 maxstep=.25 strobetimes=[0 .125 .5 .875 1] strobeoutput=all
save a y

simulator lang=spectre
